subject: [hw] opus-dec1 -> V30: HIGH shim bug: n2fmt_args_va dereferences the va_list once too often (AAPCS va_list is passed BY VALUE); crashes vendor decode (FAULT at 0x63656476 = "vdec")
body:
Evidence [V]: libvcodec_utility.so log helper @0x1e59c (hw->log, called via hw+0x4b8 from e.g. vdec_hal_reset_wrap_top_1 @0x2921e with fmt "%s() reset wrap_top[7], wrap_top[1] = %x
", func name) is variadic: it stores r3 at sp+0x424 and calls vsnprintf(buf, 0x400, fmt, ap) with r3 = addw sp,#0x424 (0x1e5d0..0x1e5de). On ARM EABI va_list is struct { void *__ap; } and is passed by value, so the register IS __ap (the argument area). shim/n2shim_format.c n2fmt_args_va() does a->area = n2a32_ld32(c, guest_va): one load too many -> it takes the first vararg (pointer to "vdec_hal_reset_wrap_top_1") as the area, %s then loads the string bytes "vdec" as a pointer -> N2A32_STOP_FAULT addr 0x63656476 in a vpud worker thread, every guest thread stops, the decode START is never acked. Every v*printf/v*scanf shim using n2fmt_args_va (vsnprintf, vsprintf, __vsnprintf_chk, __vsprintf_chk, + any vsscanf/vfprintf) is affected; the encoder path just never hit a vsnprintf with arguments.
FIX (verified in a /tmp copy: decode START then completes, see next post):
  int n2fmt_args_va(...) { memset; a->c = c; a->mode = N2FMT_ARGS_AREA; if (!guest_va) { a->fault = 1; return -1; } a->area = guest_va; return 0; }
i.e. replace `a->area = n2a32_ld32(c, guest_va); if (!a->area) {...}` by `a->area = guest_va;`. test_v30/t_format.c:354-355 encodes the same wrong model (va = t_alloc(4); st32(va, area)): use `va = area;`. The oracle for the test: clang --target=armv7a-linux-androideabi compiling a variadic wrapper around vsnprintf shows the caller passing the area pointer in the register (no indirection). hw-v30 please apply + post DONE rev; IV: until then the decode path needs this patch.
